text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of her debut race arrived.
Almond Eye gazed at the turf with sparkling eyes.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I've been thinking about it constantly.
How am I going to make my debut?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It's finally becoming a reality, isn't it?
Here—where I've visited so many times as a spectator.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Past that goal line...
I'll be the first one to cross.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
And...
I'm going to win every single race ahead!
choice_data_list: (Her eyes are overflowing with dreams and hope—)

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Heeey!
Aiii～～～～!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Gyumu~~~~~hh!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Kya!? B-Blast...!
Ease up... on the grip... a little...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, sorry, sorry!
I just really wanted to squish it tight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is Blast Onepiece.
Almond Eye's roommate, and a peer set
to debut this year as well.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ai, congrats on your debut!
Finally!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
You drew a big circle on the calendar
and were so excited... so Boo is super happy too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you for watching over me!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Boo's debut is still a little ways off!
So I'm gonna learn lots from Ai's race!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Oh? In that case, don't take your eyes off me until the very end.
Because I am definitely going to win!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That confidence... is so dazzling.
In stark contrast to her, my own heart... felt somehow shrouded in fog.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hii, Rudolf♪
You came too, I see.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...I had a feeling, but still!
You really are a diligent student council president."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Are you here to cheer on your junior? I saw the name
of the girl you were concerned about on today's race card.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Bullseye, just as expected♪
The ones you want to cheer for are... everyone, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I can hardly wait.
This year, once again—a new hope begins to run.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Stretches done!
All that's left... is to run!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye is full of potential. She can do anything she sets her mind to—my intuition tells me so. That is precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her career in the Twinkle Series begins here. Every single result
will go down in official records... with no redos allowed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A single defeat could impact her future... and might even change how she is evaluated from now on.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Are you feeling anxious?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Are you thinking that I might lose?
choice_data_list: ...Ngh! No, that's not what I meant—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Before a race, all I think about is winning. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Look at me.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
âLook.
You can see victory right before your eyes, can't you?
